raw_text:
PLAN "Postpartum On-Ramp: 10 Weeks Post"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary general_fitness:
    name "Rebuild baseline strength and core control"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 25m "Breath and Core Reconnection":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2x10 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          pelvic_tilt 2x10 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x10 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 2x6 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 2x6 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 2m
          child_pose 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 25m "Gentle Full Body":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2x8 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          goblet_squat 2x8 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 2x10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          scapular_retraction 2x12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x10 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 25m "Breath, Posture and Walk":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pelvic_tilt 2x10 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          dead_bug 2x6 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          prone_Y 2x8 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          external_rotation 2x10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 2x6 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 10m
          child_pose 2m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Core and Lower Body":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2x8 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 2x8 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          side_plank 2x1 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
          cat_cow 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Upper Body and Posture":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          arm_circles 1m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_row 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          push_up 2x6..8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          shoulder_press 2x8..10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          prone_Y 2x10 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 2x8 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          lat_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Full Body Circuit Prep":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 2x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 2x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 2x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 2x8 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 10m
          figure_four_stretch 2m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Lower Body Strength":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          hip_circles 1m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          reverse_lunge 2x8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Upper Body Strength":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          arm_circles 1m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          shoulder_press 2x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 2x12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          side_plank 2x1 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          spinal_twist 2m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Full Body and Carries":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          step_up 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 2x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          push_up 2x8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          suitcase_carry 3x1 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 2x10 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 10m
          child_pose 2m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Lower Body Baseline":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          leg_swings 1m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          pigeon_pose 2m
          hamstring_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Upper Body Baseline":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          arm_circles 1m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_row 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          tricep_extension 2x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 2x10 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          lat_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Full Body Baseline":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          reverse_lunge 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          push_up 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          farmers_walk 3x1 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 2x1 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          pallof_press 2x10 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 10m
          cat_cow 2m

goals.name: Rebuild baseline strength and core control
